## 1. Prediction market

In the [Polymarket winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), confirmed reading of September 26, 12:00 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 0.60pp, to 56.15% (USD 11.91M), and Lula gives up 1.00pp, to 42.50% (USD 12.33M), against the certified reading of September 25 at 17:08 BRT. The gap goes from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, the first widening between confirmed readings since September 21. Normalized by the pair sum, which fell from 99.05 to 98.65, the move is 0.84pp to each side. Total accumulated volume in the presidential book adds up to USD 155.40M across 19 contracts, USD 0.31M above the previous certified reading.

Neither of them is at an extreme of the series recorded since April 14: Flávio Bolsonaro stands 5.55pp from the top, 61.70% of September 21, and Lula 8.00pp from the floor, 34.50% of April 25. In the same book, the Renan Santos contract gives up 0.25pp, to 0.45% (USD 14.48M), below every point recorded up to September 25, and it remains the one with the largest accumulated volume in the presidential book.

In the [runner-up book](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), Lula gives up 0.90pp, to 24.45% (USD 0.99M), and Flávio Bolsonaro stands still at 74.50% (USD 1.16M). In the [third place one](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place), Augusto Cury rises 0.30pp, to 41.35% (USD 0.28M), and Renan Santos stays at 45.50% (USD 0.41M), so the distance between the two closes from 4.45pp to 4.15pp. Ronaldo Caiado remains at 14.50% (USD 0.17M).

In the [contract on the party with the most Senate seats](https://polymarket.com/event/next-brazil-senate-election-most-seats-won), the PL rises 3.50pp, to 92.50% (USD 0.27M), more than any presidential contract since the previous confirmed reading, and the MDB gives up 1.10pp, to 1.45%. The [Supreme Court impeachment contract](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) stays at 3.35% (USD 0.09M), with no movement, and in the [2026 inflation one](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026) the 5.00% to 5.49% band leads with 46.45% (USD 0.02M), in the 12:23 BRT reading.

## 2. What the polling firms registered

No new national poll was released on September 25 and 26, and the six of September 24 remain the most recent. What came out were state breakdowns of the presidential race: Datafolha puts Flávio Bolsonaro ahead [in São Paulo, by 38% to 33%](https://news.google.?oc=5), [in Rio de Janeiro, by 44% to 38%](https://news.google.?oc=5) and [in the Federal District, by 41% to 34%](https://news.google.?oc=5), Lula ahead [in Pernambuco, by 60% to 24%](https://news.google.?oc=5), and a [statistical tie in Minas Gerais](https://news.google.?oc=5), with 39% to 37% for Lula.

The TSE registry adds up to 1,162 presidential polls, 24 more than on September 25.

## 3. What the press covered

In the Master case, the Superior Council of the Federal Prosecution Service (MPF) [kept Paulo Gonet on the cases by 9-0](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/09/25/conselho-do-mpf-julga-atuacao-de-paulo-gonet-no-caso-banco-master.ghtml) and [shelved by 5-4 the request for an inquiry into his conduct](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/republica/conselho-do-mpf-forma-maioria-contra-afastar-gonet-no-caso-master/) on September 25. That point had stood at 4-3 in favour of opening and [ended in shelving](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxNeHVjeWIxQlA3WTZBSzVhYVpxNDdCaW5BSzA2cEJTTDlvZXlGZnZBQWk3Qjg5THktNVBxbm9DRC0xLXZpY25BdXRQSVYtTUtXM3FuODQ3VENvN3YwdzhucTB0akdHcGxfVS1FNmdvMy12RmZGcE1GeUVYWC1PaldJTkVnNGhZa01tLWljQTdyUXVkTFRrODVZc3g4QzZVZll6ellv?oc=5) with the last two votes, the final one cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, [who followed the rapporteur](https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2026/09/25/conselho-do-mpf-julga-atuacao-de-paulo-gonet-no-caso-banco-master.ghtml). [Estadão](https://www.estadao.com.br/politica/vorcaro-foi-a-almoco-em-homenagem-a-gonet-em-janeiro-de-2024/) and [VEJA](https://veja.abril.com.br/politica/vorcaro-vou-estar-no-almoco-com-gonet-gilmar-deve-estar/) record that Daniel Vorcaro, in custody since November 17, 2025, attended on January 31, 2024 a lunch in honour of Gonet, who claims to have no friendship with the banker.

At the Supreme Court, the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro [ended in conviction by 7-3](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/republica/eduardo-bolsonaro-condenacao-stf-tabata-amaral/), in a virtual trial concluded on the night of September 25, with a one-year sentence of detention to be served initially in the open regime for defaming congresswoman Tabata Amaral. The rapporteur was Alexandre de Moraes, and André Mendonça, Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques [voted for acquittal](https://www.gazetadopovo.com.br/republica/eduardo-bolsonaro-condenacao-stf-tabata-amaral/). On the same day, Mendonça [ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts](https://news.google.?oc=5) carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint.

In government, the Finance Ministry [published late on the night of September 25 the ordinance](https://oglobo.globo.com/economia/noticia/2026/09/26/as-vesperas-das-eleicoes-fazenda-prorroga-por-30-dias-subsidio-de-r-212-por-litro-do-diesel.ghtml) that keeps for another 30 days the subsidy of R$ 2.12 per litre of diesel, whose R$ 1.12 portion was due to expire on September 26, and the newspaper records that the amount does not rise. On the same night, the government [published the provisional measure that bans betting sites](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9Fbm5nLUtVV1I4dkZobTlOWFNJdjFodG8zVW1ubE54eVZjc1pDaDZwVXYyZENFOTJVZ01qWFJnV3RSQ1ZrcnRKMk5PRUc1T0t3SnF0d3ZDTW5Xei1JbVZkbmJZcDFuS1V6VXdmaFQzRmNPQQ?oc=5). Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign [says Lula is using it to respond to pressure over household debt](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/09/campanha-de-flavio-diz-que-lula-reage-a-pressao-sobre-endividamento-com-fim-de-bets-e-minimiza-ganho-eleitoral.shtml), and the candidate [called the measure an electoral swindle](https://news.google.?oc=5); Lula's campaign [will preach the tactical vote](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/colunas/painel/2026/09/campanha-de-lula-pregara-voto-util-na-ultima-semana-antes-do-primeiro-turno.shtml) in the last week before the first round, according to Folha.

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market x poll:** the gap widens 1.60pp in favour of Flávio Bolsonaro with no new national poll. In the six most recent national polls, of September 24, Lula is ahead in the first round in four, tied in one and behind in one, and Flávio Bolsonaro is ahead in the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) in four.

> **Raw x normalized:** in the runner-up book, Flávio Bolsonaro stands still at 74.50% in the raw figure and gains 0.68pp normalized, because it is Lula's price that falls and the pair sum goes from 99.85 to 98.95.

> **Thin book x thick book:** the PL's 3.50pp in the Senate happen in a book of USD 0.31M accumulated, about 500 times smaller than the presidential one, of USD 155.40M, where no contract moved more than 1.00pp.

## In summary

**The gap reopened for the first time since September 21, and the widening is small next to the closing that came before it.** It goes from 12.05pp to 13.65pp, after having fallen since the 22.40pp of September 21.

**With no new national poll, the calendar concentrates next week.** Quaest and Nexus are registered for September 28, September 29 has seven rows in the table, and Datafolha registered October 1.

**The Master case moved through a collegiate decision, and the Supreme Court concluded the case against Eduardo Bolsonaro.** The Supreme Court impeachment contract stayed at 3.35%, with no movement, and the panel links neither to the other.
